checks.check: Two-pane responsive list/draft layout, explicit root/scope/filter/counts and all error/empty/recovery states.
checks.evidence: renderer.ts builds a `<section class="detail">` (registration/draft pane) and a `<section class="list">` (connections list pane) inside `.manager`, with `#root` select (Registered repository), `#scope` select (saved/temporary), `filter-all/saved/temporary` buttons showing counts, `#counts` text, and a `@media(max-width:760px)` rule collapsing field grids/row height for narrow widths. All list states (loading/ready/empty-registry/empty-filter/read-error/offline/no-repository/upgrade-required) have copy in `statuses{}` and are exercised by the 'real renderer covers every descriptor, all list states...' test; operation recovery cards (`renderOperations`) map errorCode -> guidance text and recovery actions (reconcile/replay/activation/cleanup/refresh/dismiss), exercised by the mutation/removal tests feeding into this view.

checks.check: Strict allowlisted webview intent messages, CSP/escaping, no raw capabilities/config/secret persistence via setState or generic RPC bridge.
checks.evidence: types.ts `parseConnectionIntent` allowlists exact message shapes per `type` (closed set in `simple`, per-type field checks, exact key-set match, path allowlist for browse-file restricted to `["path"]`/`["schemaSource","path"]`), verified by the 'exact bounded intent shapes reject authority fields, accessors, stale protocol and generic RPC' test (rejects rpc/method, extra capability field, prototype paths, oversized generation, control chars, getter traps). The same test asserts the generated document's CSP meta (`default-src 'none'`, `connect-src 'none'`, `form-action 'none'`), nonce-scoped single `<script>`, and that `CONNECTION_MANAGER_SCRIPT` contains no `innerHTML|setState|getState|localStorage|sessionStorage|fetch(|XMLHttpRequest|eval(`. The RendererHarness test fixture additionally poisons `localStorage/sessionStorage/indexedDB/fetch/getState/setState` so any such call would throw under every host.test.ts case, and all 7 cases pass.

checks.check: Accessible labels/focus-visible/status region; masked replacement fields; dirty close/hide handled without ending owner.
checks.evidence: `label()` pairs every input via `htmlFor`/`id`; icon buttons carry `aria-label`+`title`, verified by 'registration precedes list at every width and toolbar icons retain accessible names'. CSS defines `:focus-visible{outline:...}` and the document uses `aria-live="polite"` on status regions, both asserted directly. Credential replacement inputs are `type=password`, start blank, erased on hide/pagehide (`eraseSecrets`), and the primary host test confirms posts never contain entered secret values and reopened drafts show blank password fields. Dirty close/hide is exercised in the primary host test: hiding the panel while a draft is dirty drops a queued 'save' message (`f.calls.length` unchanged) without ending the session (`f.owner.view.status` stays `'ready'`), and closing with a dirty draft opens the confirm dialog; cancelling leaves the panel open and the owner untouched, confirming only on explicit accept.

verdict.reason: Typecheck and the required integration test (and its sibling cases in the same file) pass; the host/renderer/types code genuinely implements the two-pane list/draft view, the strict allowlisted intent protocol with CSP/no-persistence guarantees, and accessible/masked/dirty-close behavior claimed by the acceptance checks, with changes confined to vscode-plugin/src/connections/{host.ts,renderer.ts,types.ts} and their tests/fixtures as the task scoped.
